First, determine UTC offsets:  
Asia/Singapore is UTC+8 (historical standard). US/Eastern is UTC-5 (standard time).  

Source time: 19:00 (Oct 17) in UTC+8 → UTC = 19:00 − 8 = 11:00 (Oct 17).  
Target (US/Eastern) = 11:00 + (-5) = 06:00 (Oct 17).  

No day change in this conversion.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 06:00
